validatedNamed: Interparking España / P-APP & WEB Servicios Digitales
consistencyNote: The repository reconciles 15 fully source-validated CPOs by name and preserves the historical gap of 10 earlier validated names instead of guessing them. Tesla Supercharger, Feníe Energía public charging and PowerGo have official station-level tariff paths but incomplete national tariff coverage, so they remain active rather than being promoted as fully validated.

active.name: Tesla Supercharger
active.status: official national station inventory complete at 105 entries; exact station/time/vehicle-class tariff coverage remains 1/105 (Córdoba location 4002559). Repeated public station-page probing has not exposed numeric tariffs for the other stations; do not repeat the same investigation again without a new official/guest tariff surface.

active.name: Feníe Energía public charging
active.status: new official station-level pricing path confirmed at recarga.fenieenergia.es/punto-recarga/{id}. Seven exact station examples are seeded, demonstrating site-specific prices from 0.15 to 0.50 EUR/kWh plus optional session fees. Continue station inventory/enumeration; never generalize by power or network name.

active.name: PowerGo
active.status: official locations-and-tariffs surface exposes exact station prices and PowerGo states tariffs are dynamic. Two Spanish stations are seeded (+B Energías Sueca and Selwo Aventura). Continue Spanish station enumeration and preserve payment-channel surcharges separately.

excludedNonCpoOrPlatform.name: EVcharge / Etecnic
excludedNonCpoOrPlatform.reason: Official EVcharge/Etecnic material describes a charge-point management SaaS/platform used by municipalities, companies and other operators, with customer-configurable tariffs by time, power and user group. Do not count the platform name itself as a physical CPO or propagate one tariff across stations unless a specific station's physical operator is independently identified.

excludedNonCpoOrPlatform.name: Electromaps / Electromaps SL
excludedNonCpoOrPlatform.reason: Electromaps' current official FAQ states charging tariffs are set by the station owner or CPO, may vary by kWh/minute/fixed fee, and Electromaps can add its own service surcharge. Treat Electromaps as an eMSP/aggregation platform for tariff purposes, not as a physical CPO identity to which one direct tariff can be propagated. Resolve the underlying physical CPO per station/EVSE instead.
